encodings: *B64 = RFC 4648 §4 standard base64 WITH "=" padding (tweetnacl-util); *Hex = lowercase hex; *Json / wire = exact UTF-8 string as emitted by JSON.stringify; rng.draws = PRNG draws in call order (see README.md#prng)
notes: POST <STORAGE_BASE>/api/keys/publish. Body JSON = {"publicKey","signingPublicKey","ts","signature"} — ts is a decimal STRING, signature = b64 Ed25519 over UTF-8 of `${publicKey}|${signingPublicKey}|${uid}|${ts}` (the two keys as their base64 strings).

Server (routes_keys.py) rebuilds the canonical string with the JWT user_id and rejects |now − ts| > 5 min ("stale publish signature") or a bad signature (401). Unsigned publishes are still accepted during rollout.
Signed with the NEW signing key being published (self-signature, no dependency on a previously stored key).
